title: Transcriptional profiling of activated CD4+ memory T cells exposed to anti-TNF and recombinant human TNF-alpha in vitro
description: We performed an RNA-seq analysis on FACS-sorted CD4+ memory T cells (Tmem, CD4+CD25-CD45RA-) stimulated in vitro with anti-CD3/CD28 coated beads (1:5), IL-2 (100 U/mL) in the presence of  a TNF-alpha inhibitor (Etanercept, ETN, 5 μg/mL) or recombinant human TNF-alpha (rhTNF-alpha, 50 ng/mL). The cells were cultured for three days at 37°C and 5% CO2. On day three Tmem were lysed (Buffer RLT supplemented with DTT, QIAGEN) and RNA extraction was performed (RNeasy Plus Micro kit), followed by sample preparation with TruSeq (polyA) mRNA kits (Illumina), RNA sequencing (carried out on an Illumina HiSeq2500), and the alignment of trimmed fastQ files to GRCh38 human reference genome. We also performed a Quality control (QC). This was done using the tool FastQC FastQC/0.11.3-Java-1.7.0_80. QC metrics were calculated for the aligned reads using Picard-tools picard/1.130-Java-1.7.0_80, CollectRnaSeqMetrics, MarkDuplicates, CollectInsertSize-Metrics and SAMtools/1.2-foss-2015b flagstat. Finally, we carried out a Differential expression gene (DEG) analysis using DESeq2, in order to evaluate the impact of ETN and rhTNF-alpha on Transcriptome profiling of stimulated CD4+ Tmem. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) was carried out to visualize the samples given their entire transcriptome and any remaining batch effects.

samples.title: ETN treatment_Donor 1
samples.description: Protocols: CD4+ T cells derived from healthy volunteers were isolated using Rosette Sep CD4+ enrichment cocktail (CAT#15022, StemCell® Technologies) (50 μL/ml of whole blood) according to the instructions of the supplier. To sort CD4+CD25-CD45RA- (Tmem) the purified CD4+ cells were washed and surface stained with anti-CD25-BV510® (M-A251, BD), anti-CD45RA- PE®(4KB5, Dako) and CD4-PE-Cy5.5® (13B8.2, Beckman-Coulter) and FACS-sorted on a FACSAria™ III machine (BD). FACS-sorted CD4+ Tmem cells (2.5 x 104 cells/well) were cultured in 96-well U-bottom plates and incubated with Dynabeads® Human T-Activator CD3/CD28 (1:5, bead:cell ratio) (Cat# 111.31D, Gibco®) and recombinant human IL-2 (rhIL-2) (100 U/mL) (Proleukin Prometheus Laboratories) for three days at 37C with 5% CO2. RPMI-1640 Dutch modified (Gibco®) culture medium, with sodium bicarbonate and 20 mM HEPES, supplemented with penicillin/streptomycin (100 U/mL), sodium pyruvate (1 mM), glutamine/glutamax and 10% human pooled serum (HPS, Radboudumc), was used in all conditions.] FACS-sorted CD4+ Tmem cultured as described in Protocol 2 (Growth protocol) were supplemented with TNF inhibitor (etanercept, Enbrel®, 5 µg/mL, Pfizer). On day three of culture the cells were pooled and RNA extraction was carried out. Total RNA was extracted from lysed CD4+ Tmem by using the RNeasy Plus Micro kit (Qiagen). Initial quality check and RNA quantification of the samples were performed by capillary electrophoresis using the LabChip GX (Perkin Elmer). Non-degraded RNA-samples were selected for subsequent sequencing analysis. Sequence libraries were generated using the TruSeq (polyA) mRNA sample preparation kits (Illumina) using the Sciclone NGS Liquid Handler (Perkin Elmer).
attributes: anti-CD3/CD28-coated bead (1:5, bead:cell ratio) stimulation + recombinant human IL-2 (100 U/mL)
